name: Conservation, Community, and Education Grants
summary: Alberta Conservation Association grants for non-research projects related to wildlife, fish, habitats, conservation education and outdoor activities in Alberta.
reporting: Recipients must provide a progress report by September 1, 2027 and a final report by March 15, 2028.

eligibility.rule: The project takes place within Alberta
Individual applicants have the required insurance
The project applies to only one ACA grant program
The grant is not used for overhead, fundraising, out-of-Alberta travel, or out-of-term costs
Required permits, licenses, and permissions are obtained before the project starts

eligibility.quote: No, the grants are for projects taking place within Alberta only.
Individuals can apply for funding from the CCEG, but you have to have the proper insurance, such as WCB, liability insurance for any work done on your property, etc.
A project can only apply to one ACA grant program.
Not use the grant for overhead expenses, general fundraising, travel to/from Alberta from outside Alberta, and costs made before the start date or after the end date of the agreement.

The RECIPIENT shall perform all work in accordance with all applicable laws, regulations, rules, codes and ordinances of authorities having jurisdiction and will obtain any and all permits/licenses and permissions required to carry out activities described in this agreement prior to the start of the project

after_award.quote: Provide a progress report to ACA by September 1, 2026. The progress report should be in ACA's template, which can be found on ACA's website www.ab-conservation.com
